title: Toronto laneway-suite fire-access alternative-solution application (2019 case summarized by City)

facts.text: Toronto Building reported that a laneway-suite permit applicant brought an alternative-solution proposal to the Building Code Commission after the City had not issued a permit.
facts.locator: City report, PDF p. 6, 'Building Code Commission Decision'

facts.text: The proposed access route was reported as 1.0 m wide and approximately 73 m from the closest point in the street, compared with the City's 45 m requirement described in the report.
The report says the applicant proposed sprinkler protection, fire-rated exterior walls, and non-combustible cladding as mitigating measures.
The City report says the Commission found the measures met Code objectives and directed that a permit be issued.
